title: Legacy refined quality profile shared by ProPainter and DiffuEraser
body: CONFIRMED in working tree: Cleaner requests default to quality_profile=legacy_refined. Both official engines use scene-local dual subtitle masks; inference uses stable context masks and final composition/audit use tight masks. Global enhancement remains off by default. The worker reports profile and selected engine under pipeline revision scene-roi-v4. Python focused suite: 42 passed. Frontend focused suite: 17 passed. TypeScript noEmit: passed.
